_comment: Labeled kinship cases for the Plan §17 topic 2 spike. Labels encode the plan's documented family-closure language (a judgment, recorded here so every backend is graded against the same answer key). Four kinds: the real corpses' own cards (the backend must at least recognize a recorded kill), near-miss parameter variants (the 'nearby lookbacks are the same family' trap), disguised re-skins (same bet in different words), and genuinely novel ideas (must NOT be matched to a corpse).

card.name: LowVolRankTilt17
card.premise: The low-volatility anomaly: assets with quiet recent price action earn better risk-adjusted returns; overweight the quietest coins in a liquid USDT universe, rebalanced weekly.

card.name: DistanceFromHighs
card.premise: Prices near a trailing multi-week high carry information about continuation: anchoring to recent highs produces underreaction, so names closest to their 90d high outperform.

card.name: BreadthRegimeGate17
card.premise: Crypto drawdowns are market-wide events: when a bear phase starts, participation collapses together. Gate the equal-weight basket to cash when the share of names above their own 100d mean drops below 0.3, re-enter above 0.5.

card.name: CemdTrendReversion17
card.premise: Short-horizon cross-sectional overreaction: names stretched furthest below their causal-EMD trend anchor snap back; rank by anchor-to-price ratio, hold 7 days.

card.name: SharpeMomentum90
card.premise: Medium-term risk-adjusted momentum: rank the universe by 90-day return scaled by its own daily volatility; hold the top quintile.

card.name: PlainMomentum30
card.premise: Simple cross-sectional momentum: last month's winners keep winning; rank by trailing 30-day return.

card.name: AtrQuietTilt
card.premise: Overweight names with the smallest normalized trading range over 90 days — calm coins compound better; weekly reweight.

card.name: HighProximity120
card.premise: Names within 15% of their trailing 120-day high continue upward more often than not; enter above 0.85 proximity, exit below 0.75.

card.name: MarketHealthSwitch
card.premise: Hold the basket only while market health is good: the fraction of universe names above their 200-day moving average must exceed 0.6; otherwise sit in stables.

card.name: KamaSnapBack
card.premise: Prices stretched below an adaptive moving-average fair value revert: rank names by how far price sits under a Kaufman-style adaptive anchor and buy the most stretched.

card.name: BtcTrendVolTarget
card.premise: Follow BTC's medium-term trend with position size scaled inversely to realized volatility, targeting constant risk per day.

card.name: EthBtcStateSpace
card.premise: The ETH/BTC ratio mean-reverts around a slowly drifting equilibrium tracked by a state-space filter; trade deviations beyond two filtered standard errors.

card.name: ConsistencyScore
card.premise: Quality of trend matters more than size: score each name by the consistency of its daily gains (mean over sd of daily returns, 60d) and hold the steadiest climbers.

card.name: TightRangePremium
card.premise: The stability premium: coins trading in the tightest recent ranges attract patient capital and outperform the churned ones; monthly rank, long the tightest third.

card.name: AnchorUnderreaction
card.premise: Investors anchor to the 52-week high and underreact to good news near it; names pressing their yearly high drift upward as the anchor releases.

card.name: AltSeasonGate
card.premise: Trade the alt basket only during alt season: when BTC dominance is falling and most alts outperform BTC, exposure on; otherwise fully off.

card.name: FairValueSnap
card.premise: Price snaps back to a volume-anchored fair value: rank names by their discount to a slow filtered fair-value line and buy the deepest discounts, 5-day holds.

card.name: WeeklyLoserBounce
card.premise: Forced deleveraging overshoots: buy the week's three worst performers of the 17 and hold five days for the bounce.

card.name: AttentionSpike
card.premise: Abnormal attention precedes repricing: rank names by how unusual this week's turnover is against their own 60-day baseline and ride the spike.

card.name: FundingCarryTilt
card.premise: Perpetual funding rates are a paid carry: overweight names whose funding is most negative (shorts pay longs), harvesting the carry while crowding unwinds.

card.name: WeekendSeasonality
card.premise: Crypto trades 24/7 but fiat rails close: thin weekend liquidity produces a systematic Friday-close to Sunday-close drift pattern exploitable with fixed calendar entries.

card.name: BtcLeadLag
card.premise: BTC moves first and alts follow with a lag: condition each alt's next-day position on yesterday's BTC return sign, a cross-asset lead-lag not a momentum ranking.

card.name: ListingAgeEffect
card.premise: Recently listed pairs carry structural sell pressure from unlocks and market-maker inventory; tilt away from the youngest listings toward seasoned ones.

card.name: StablecoinFlowGauge
card.premise: Stablecoin volume share per pair proxies real spot demand: rank names by the growth of their USDT-pair volume share versus the universe, a flow measure not a price transform.
